responsibility: Owns the architecture-independent inline-assembly target layer: shared register-definition macros, modifier metadata, parsing and validation plumbing, architecture module integration, and cross-architecture enums and clobber-ABI coordination used to expose per-target register sets to the compiler.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the `abi` and `spec` `mod.rs` files, this module is the shared inline-assembly framework: it defines the register-description macros, common asm enums/parsing/validation scaffolding, per-arch integration, and clobber-ABI mappings.
